en: Okay, so lemme explain about how to{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}communicate with other worlds{f 0 1 0}.{PAGE}The deal is, there are apparently a ton{SAUT}of worlds besides this one out there.{PAGE}So, like, in those other worlds, there{SAUT}are other "you"s...{PAGE}And they're all trying to communicate{SAUT}with your world from theirs.

But first we'll need a name. So the{SAUT}other yous can tell you apart,{SAUT}and stuff.
Hmm... Well, it's a name that goes{SAUT}in the P-Book, so...
Let's call it your {f 0 1 2}P-Book Name{f 0 1 0}!{PAGE}You can change it whenever, so just{SAUT}give me something to write down.
